commands.summary: Plan and execute the archive submission reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: external mutation; archives a live DocuSeal submission (soft-delete, still recoverable via the DocuSeal UI); approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the archive template reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: external mutation; archives a live DocuSeal template (soft-delete, recoverable by unarchiving via update_template); approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the clone template reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: external mutation; creates a new live DocuSeal template by cloning an existing one; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create submission reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: external mutation; dispatches a live signature-request email/SMS to every listed submitter unless send_email/send_sms are explicitly set false; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Run the template detail ETL stream
Plan and execute the update submitter reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: external mutation; overwrites a live DocuSeal submitter's pre-filled values/contact info, can re-send signature request notifications, and can force-mark the submitter completed/auto-signed; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update template reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: external mutation; renames/moves/relabels a live DocuSeal template and can unarchive it; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
